mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in residential construction activity (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust household demand and economic confidence, directly translating to higher corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A Federal Funds Rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates for equity valuations and causing immediate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates supply constraints outpacing demand, triggering inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines and HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market with unemployment below 3.5% (UNRATE < 3.5%) drives wage growth that compresses corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1500 thousand units (HOUST > 1500) signals strong consumer demand for durable goods, boosting near-term corporate revenues and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL rising) without corresponding monetary policy response (FEDFUNDS stable) indicates central bank inaction, causing equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating unemployment (UNRATE increasing > 0.3 percentage points in 3 months) signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE increases > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, directly supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.05.
